scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/emit-tool-shell.mjs && node scripts/emit-community-suites.mjs && node scripts/doctor.mjs && node scripts/emit-cloudflare-root.mjs
scripts.test:patro-tools: vitest run tests/core.test.ts tests/tithi-events.test.ts tests/sait-baby.test.ts tests/language.test.ts tests/bots-letters.test.ts
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.preview:cloudflare: npm run build && wrangler dev --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:migrate: npm run cloudflare:config && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev --config wrangler.pages.jsonc
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy --config wrangler.pages.jsonc

bindings.ASSETS: Static SPA assets served by the Worker.
bindings.DB: Optional during bootstrap; set CF_D1_DATABASE_ID for native D1 calendar/content reads.
bindings.CACHE: Optional during bootstrap; set CF_KV_NAMESPACE_ID for persistent upstream/API cache.
